name: Single tree point clouds from terrestrial laser scanning

affiliation.name: Silviculture and Forest Ecology of the temperate Zone
Silviculture and Forest Ecology of the temperate Zone

description: Single tree point clouds from terrestrial laser scanning obtained from laserscanning campaigns throughout Germany and an additional dataset from a campaign on the Christy Flats, near Eugene, Oregeon, USA. Files are sorted by species (ash, beech, Doglas-Fir, Oak, Maple, Pine, RedOak, Spruce) and are in the format .pts, .xyz and .txt.
